# Implement logged-out forgot-password request with Resend email

## Summary

Let unauthenticated users open a forgot-password screen from the login page, submit an email, and always see the same success messaging. For eligible active `ADMIN` users, persist a hashed single-use token (TTL ≤ 1 hour per PRD assumptions) and send a reset link via Resend using typed `@hermes/env` configuration.

## Scope

- In scope: Dedicated route(s) or route-action-gen handlers for the request step; `env.example` + `@hermes/env` for Resend API key, sender, and public dashboard base URL for links; email body with HTTPS reset URL; logging of send success/failure without leaking secrets; generic client response in all cases (anti-enumeration).
- Out of scope: Page to enter new password (TICKET-004); rate-limit middleware (TICKET-005) unless stubbed—prefer leaving hooks for TICKET-005.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] From `/login`, user can navigate to a forgot-password screen and submit an email; labels and keyboard flow match existing login patterns (REQ-001).
- [ ] Server always returns the same user-visible success outcome whether the email exists, is admin, or is inactive; no enumeration via copy (REQ-001).
- [ ] For active `ADMIN` users only: create token record (hashed at rest), bind to user, set expiry ≤ 1 hour; send email via Resend with link to reset UI (REQ-002, REQ-003).
- [ ] Resend failures are logged; user still sees generic success (REQ-002).
- [ ] New env vars documented and wired through `@hermes/env` per project norms (PRD §6 Config).

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-001
- Blocks: none (TICKET-004 consumes tokens)

## Notes

Link format (opaque id vs secret in query) is an implementation detail; token must not appear in logs. REQ-007 structured logging can land in TICKET-006; minimal logging here should still avoid raw tokens.
